description: This source file contains utility functions and class definitions for generating geometry data such as spheres and cubes, including their vertices, normals, texture coordinates, and indices. It defines classes SphereGeometry and CubeGeometry, and functions CreateSphereGeometry and GenerateCubeGeometry.

classes.name: SphereGeometry
classes.description: Class representing sphere geometry data, including positions, normals, and indices.

classes.name: CubeGeometry
classes.description: Class representing cube geometry data, including positions, normals, texture coordinates, and indices.

methods.name: CreateSphereGeometry
methods.description: Generates vertices, normals, and indices for a sphere with specified slice count and radius.

methods.name: GenerateCubeGeometry
methods.description: Generates vertices, normals, texture coordinates, and indices for a cube with specified radius.
